data.turoyo: <...> B kul dukṯo (xu greʕo, d howe maṣro bu moro) kəmnagəl qəm i siyase di 'türkleştirme', d maḥətla li dawle d Kamal. <...>
data.translation: <...> Everywhere (like a servant who is bound to his master) he clears the way before the policy of ‘türkleştirme’ that Kemal's state laid down. <...>

rationale: Only attestation of new figurative qəm-construction 2; the Turoyo has no overt noun meaning road.

summary: New sense 2: (fig., mit qəm-) einer Sache den Weg bereiten, sie fördern

data.turoyo: Qurme annaqqa, kul qurmo haqqayṣ, mnagelan, ḥət biyya, ḥət ʕafro, ḥət kašše, ḥət dawmo, mʕarəm ʕafro, ʕafro, ʕafro, ʕafro w de de de matʕablan ruḥayna.
data.translation: Logs this big, each log on its own; we gathered them up. Put them in, put earth, put brushwood, put a tree, heap earth, earth, earth, earth, and on, on, on; we wore ourselves out.

rationale: Distinct 1pl l-series mnagelan with fronted logs as material to clear/gather, complementing inherited place objects; selected for form/valency, not an unverified thin-cell count.
